notes: 60 runs: all default 3 profiles by 2 goals, 5 predeclared policies, 2 fresh seeds and one 120-interaction fixed observable-state scenario. The original fixture has already been studied; this is fresh seed replication, not fresh content. All five variants and unchanged controls are declared before outcomes and must enter the held-out stage; no outcome-based tuning or shortlist selection. Soft frontier and cross-category recency are separate variants, never combined. The base calendar remains 12 interactions/day, 2 minutes apart, with a 7-day delayed probe.
